title: Plot Twist: Spot the Drama
one_line: Spot the differences in soap-opera scenes: weddings, first dates, office meltdowns and more.
how_to_play: Two pictures, one scene. Tap anything that changed in either picture. Wrong taps cost a heart; pinch or scroll to zoom, and use a hint if you're stuck.
description:
Plot Twist is a spot-the-difference game with a soap-opera heart. Every level is a dramatic scene: a wedding objection, a disastrous first date, a reply-all office scandal. Two pictures, one scene, and something has changed.

Tap anything that is different in either picture: a missing cushion, a new pair of glasses, a shocked face, a cat facing the other way. A wrong tap costs a heart. Pinch or scroll to zoom in, and drag to look around. If you are stuck, a hint shows one difference, and hints refill over time. Find them fast to build combos, and finish quickly with no mistakes for three stars.

The episodes never end and get trickier as you go, and there is a new Daily Drama every day to keep your streak alive. It is fun because the scenes are silly and every find feels like a small win. It is for anyone who loves a good drama and has sharp eyes, from teens to grandparents.
controls: Tap a difference in either picture
Pinch or scroll to zoom, drag to look around
Tap Hint when you are stuck
tips: Look at faces, hands and the edges first. Small changes hide there.
Scan one corner at a time instead of the whole picture.
Slow down when you are low on hearts.
story: I enjoy spot-the-difference games, and I thought the drama of soap operas would make them more fun. I made it with Claude, and every scene is drawn in code, so there is always a new episode to play.
